platform: iOS, initially single-user personal app; architecture extensible for later commercialization

launch_screen.visual: large calligraphic 说 as central tappable element

secondary_actions: Reprendre une séance interrompue if applicable
home.tutor_of_day: avatar + Chinese name; one tutor per session

session_ui.word_card: large hanzi, pinyin, French meaning; elements may hide progressively later
session_ui.model_badge: actual model name continuously visible with complexity color code
session_ui.latency_feedback: short Mandarin transition from a prewritten library (~10 variants); discreet wait sound if useful after user testing

tutors.identity: stable voice + Chinese name + simple recognizable vector avatar

review_mode.selection: fragile + old + recent-to-confirm + structural + occasional strong items

developer_mode.product_learning: journal meaningful setting changes and metrics automatically; no heavy formal A/B test workflow

cost_target.policy: quality wins when uncertain; alerts, not hard cutoff
